senses.zh_definition: 英语人名 Zooey；具体指称须依上下文确定，例如塞林格作品《Franny and Zooey》中的人物。
senses.en_definition: An English-language personal name, including the name of a character in J. D. Salinger’s Franny and Zooey.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang dalam penggunaan bahasa Inggeris, termasuk nama watak dalam karya Franny and Zooey oleh J. D. Salinger.
senses.nuances: 词性细分为专有名词，正文应写作 Zooey。输入没有提供具体人物，不能自动认定所指对象、性别或姓名词源。此处是名称说明，并非 DBP 普通词释义；official 不表示该名称获认定为马来语普通词。所列搭配为教学示例，未经频率核验。[出版社作品介绍](https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/j-d-salinger/franny-and-zooey/9780316450720/?lens=little-brown)

etymology.historical_story: Zooey has a documented literary association through J. D. Salinger’s Franny and Zooey, which brings together two works about the Glass family. That association establishes a real use of the name, but not the identity intended by an isolated corpus token. Without that context, assigning one pronunciation or a single ancestral meaning would exceed the evidence. [Publisher’s description](https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/j-d-salinger/franny-and-zooey/9780316450720/?lens=little-brown)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先用《Franny and Zooey》的书名记住拼写；实际称呼某个人时，再把本人读音与姓名绑定记忆。
